ZAMEEN AXIS (PRIVATE) LIMITED
NOTES TO THE FINANCIAL STATEMENTS
AS AT 30 JUNE 2023
1

THE COMPANY AND ITS OPERATIONS

1.1

Corporate and general information
Zameen Axis (Private) Limited ("the Company") was incorporated on 27 February 2019 as a Private Limited Company
under the Companies Act (The Act). The Company's principal activity is to engage in the business of development of
all types of real estate including commercial markets and multi-storey buildings, shopping centres etc. The registered
office of the Company is situated at Pearl One, 94-B/I, M.M. Alam Road Gulberg III, Lahore. The Company is a
subsidiary of Zameen Venture One (Private) Limited ("the Parent Company"), a Company incorporated in Pakistan.
The ultimate parent of the company is Dubizzle Group Holdings Limited, , a Company incorporated in United Arab
Emirates (UAE).

1.2

The Company holds 50% share in EDZD Developers (the Firm), a partnership firm which was established on 28 Dec
2020 in Pakistan between Zameen Axis (Private) Limited and Earthlink Developments LLP. The firm was registered
with the Registrar of Firms under section 58 (I) of the Partnership Act, 1932 on 26 October 2018. Its primary place of
business and registered office is located at Pearl One, 94-B/I, M.M. Alam Road Gulberg III, Lahore. The principal
activity of the Firm is to undertake, manage, market and sell the project, EDZD on the land located in Bahria Town
Phase 6, GT Road Rawalpindi. The Company's owners / directors are also Partners in the Firm. As at 30 June 2023,
the project has not yet started.
The Company has incurred loss of Rs. 15,505,423 (2022: Rs. 13,671,301) and its accumulated losses as at the
reporting date amounts to Rs. 42,293,250 (2022: Rs. 26,787,827) resulting in a negative equity of Rs. 42,291,250
(2022: Rs. 26,785,827) as at that date. The Parent Company has committed to provide financial support to the
Company, enabling the Company to continue its operations as going concern and fulfil all of its financial obligation.
Based on which the financial statements of the Company are prepared on going concern basis.

2

BASIS OF PREPARATION

2.1

Statement of compliance
These financial statements have been prepared in accordance with the accounting and reporting standards as
applicable in Pakistan. The accounting and reporting standards applicable in Pakistan comprise of:
- International Financial Reporting Standards (IFRS Standards) issued by the International Accounting Standards
Board (IASB) as notified under the Companies Act, 2017; and
- Provisions of and directives issued under the Companies Act, 2017.
Where provisions of and directives issued under the Companies Act, 2017 differ from the IFRS standards, the
provisions of and directives of the Companies Act, 2017 have been followed.

2.2

Basis of measurement
These financial statements have been prepared under the historical cost convention unless otherwise stated.

2.3

Functional and presentation currency
These financial statements are presented in Pak Rupees, which is the Company’s functional currency. All figures have
been rounded off to the nearest Rupee, unless otherwise stated.

2.4

Standards, interpretations and amendments to published accounting standards
The accounting policies adopted are consistent with those of the previous financial period, except for the following
new and amended standards and interpretations effective for annual period beginning on July 01, 2022, as listed
below:

2.4.1 New Standards, Interpretations and Amendments effective in the reporting period
The accounting policies adopted in the preparation of these financial statements are consistent with those of the
previous financial year, except for following amendments to accounting standards which are effective for annual
periods beginning on or after July 01, 2022 (unless otherwise stated).
IFRS 3 Business Combinations – The amendment updates a reference in IFRS 3 to the Conceptual Framework for
Financial Reporting without changing the accounting requirements for business combinations.
